About the Toolbox

Developed by Adam Hawk to support studio practice, instruction, and experimentation at the intersection of traditional craft and digital fabrication. The library will grow as additional calculators and design applications are migrated and developed.

Experimental & Educational Use: These tools are provided for educational, exploratory, and experimental purposes. Calculations, visualizations, and generated outputs may contain errors or approximations. Independently verify dimensions, results, and suitability before fabrication or use. These tools are not a substitute for professional judgment or appropriate safety practices.
